high: factory/harness/v2-lunch-shots.mjs:183 — Tap-ownership test accepts an untappable control — `hit.contains(el)` treats an ancestor/container returned by `elementFromPoint()` as ownership success, but a tap targeting that ancestor does not dispatch the button’s click handler; an overlaid `.lmp-slots`/tray container can therefore swallow every child control while the check passes — require the hit to be the control or its descendant, or perform a real tap at every sample point and assert the intended handler/state transition.
medium: src/v2/lunch/play/lunchMenuLogic.ts:244 — Cleared sessions are not inert under `swap()` — unlike `place()` and `remove()`, `swap()` has no `phase === "cleared"` guard and will mutate a completed tray; the harness’s “cleared session is inert” assertion at factory/harness/gameplay-qa-v2-lunch-menu.mjs:226 omits `swap()`, so the defect passes — reject swaps in the cleared phase and include `swap()` in the inert-session assertion.

factory/harness/v2-lunch-shots.mjs:162 — Touch QA does not prove controls meet minimum target size — it checks overlap, viewport sampling, and a non-vacuous control count, but never asserts a 44–48 px minimum width and height; undersized yet non-overlapping controls pass — assert the approved minimum dimensions for every enabled interactive control at 375×812.

factory/harness/v2-lunch-shots.mjs:44 — Reduced-motion behavior is never exercised — the run uses only the default media preference, so broken or incomplete `prefers-reduced-motion` behavior passes despite being a stated review target — run a second browser pass with reduced motion emulated and assert the full flow remains usable and state feedback remains perceptible.
